title: Driving Accurate Allergen Prediction with Protein Language Models and Generalization-Focused Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Developing a similarity-aware cross-validation pipeline to systematically control for inter-split (training vs. test) and inter-class (allergen vs. non-allergen) sequence similarities to evaluate how uncontrolled homology inflates predictive performance.

Comparing model performance using a 'Length Control' strategy that explicitly matches the length distributions of positive and negative training sequences to prevent the model from using length differences as a simplistic heuristic or shortcut.
Evaluating the effect of skewed negative-to-positive sample ratios by training and testing models under various dataset balancing strategies (e.g., 'No Balance', 'Hard Balance', 'Minimal').
